page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at the top, centred, with the page number at the top right. Catchword alone at the bottom right. No margin notes.

main_text.p: flumina fedes habebant, in quorum numero expressè Reiderij & Westerwoldij, cum iis qui sunt in Præfecturà vetere, recensentur, semel, die octava post Pentecostes, iterum die xv Septembris, aut sæpius etiam si res poscoret, Groningæ conventum agerent, in eodē[?] causas cum magistratu oppidano recognoscerent. Atque ita legis esse coepit, quod moris liberi esse solet. Suntque multa alia præclara & egregia illic sancita, ad rem judiciariam, totumque jurisdictionis ordinem ac modum, imprimis verò ad judiciorum sanctimoniam atque integritatem pertinentia, quæ nos in Historiâ Decadis II libro IV expressimus: quæ talia sunt, ut ne eruditissimas quidem & sapientissimas civitates eorum merito possit pudere. Ad hæc fœdera vetera instaurata pacis causâ, vis omnis vetita, mulcta violatoribus gravis ære Groningano indicta. Signatum decretum sigillis Reideriorum, Præfecturæ veteris, Westerwoldiorum, Hunesgoniæ, Hummerziæ, Fivelgoniæ, Fredowoldiæ, Langowoldiæ, civitatis Groninganæ, die Magni Martyris. Hujus fœderis & decreti

page.notes: The printed line "gravis ære|Gro-" has a bracket-like sign between "ære" and "Gro-", which I could not identify and have not reproduced. "eodem" is read with a doubtful abbreviation mark ("eodē[?]"). The printed "Præfecturà" and "poscerct" are as they appear on the scan. The catchword "beneficio" is printed at the foot, right-aligned, below the last line.
